import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
for container in ax1.containers:
    ax1.bar_label(container, fmt='%.2f', fontsize=8)

# Plot 2: Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
df_age = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
sns.kdeplot(data=df_age[df_age['survived']==0], x='age', ax=ax2, label='Did not survive', 
            color='#FF6B6B', fill=True, alpha=0.5)
sns.kdeplot(data=df_age[df_age['survived']==1], x='age', ax=ax2, label='Survived', 
            color='#4ECDC4', fill=True, alpha=0.5)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')

# Plot 3: Survival count by embarkation town
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival.columns = ['Did not survive', 'Survived']
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], edgecolor='black', stacked=True)
ax3.set_title('Survival Count by Embarkation Town', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Town', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.legend(title='Survival', loc='upper right')

# Plot 4: Fare distribution by class with survival indication
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df_fare = df[df['fare'] < 300]  # Remove extreme outliers for better visualization
sns.boxplot(data=df_fare, x='pclass', y='fare', hue='survived', ax=ax4, 
            palette={0: '#FF6B6B', 1: '#4ECDC4'})
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
handles, labels = ax4.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax4.legend(handles, ['Did not survive', 'Survived'], title='Survival', loc='upper right')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
